title: governance/lifecycle record shapes
description: The record shapes this package persists to disk: the append-only decision ledger (ledger.py), the directive mailbox record (.fleet/sent|done, including the fields `retire` adds), the per-issue verify attestation (.fleet/lifecycle/<issue>.json), and one baseline.json quarantine entry. Frozen so a consumer can rely on the keys whether the record was written today or a year ago (issue #885).

ledgerRecord.description: One line of governance/lifecycle/ledger.jsonl: one decision (close/retire/consume), refusal or success, never rewritten.

directiveRecord.description: A directive mailbox record, as read from .fleet/sent/<id>.json or .fleet/done/<id>.json. `retired`/`retirement_reason`/`superseded_by` are present only once directive.retire has moved the record (issue #861).

verifyAttestation.description: The `verify` block of .fleet/lifecycle/<issue>.json — a green attestation naming the commit it was measured at.

quarantineEntry.description: One baseline.json entry: a (code, subject) pair excused only while `tracked_by` is open (issue #269 section 5).
